prose: Steven A. Young PhD traded his doctorate in nuclear physics for a digital audio workstation and an autodidactic initiation into alchemy, positive sciences, and natural physics. We discuss the first half of his book, A Fool's Wisdom, exploring his reasons for refuting the major foundational dogmas of the scientific establishment. You'll learn about the follies of atomism, nuclear, quantum & astrophysics, and how to exalt positive sciences over pointless techne of academic jargon.
ext: We probe deeper into the workings of radioactive metals and nuclear power, church bells and the vibratory nature of healing, the self-harmonizing universe, the Stephen Hawking psyop, the one-way conversion to a geocentric cosmology, the Space X space sex hex, the possible reality of the cosmic egg, and the balance of four elements as a framework for health and coherence.
